issues.on_page: Grants 32,996 (Statement of Activities p2: Public Safety capital receipts and contributions)

issues.on_page: Public Safety Grant 10,000 (Water fund nonoperating; SoA p3 Water capital receipts and contributions)

issues.on_page: Cash in Bank 905,259 + Cash with County Treasurer 18,274 + Restricted Cash 1,762,989; TOTAL ASSETS 2,686,522
issues.issue: Ending cash is a sum of the printed cash lines, correctly marked computed. It equals the printed Total Assets, since every asset is cash. Noted only because of the 2026-11-06 'cash is never derived' ruling. FY2024 JSON beginning_fund_balance 2,686,522 and business-type beginning 3,882,643 tie to FY2023 ending as printed.
